title: Iterative probe collage - compact run diary
content:
Purpose: informal single-file scratchpad to track a few quick probes over the last 3 weeks. Goal is to capture fragments, rough numbers, and action items so I don’t lose context between spikes of work.

Topline summary:
- Running small multi-factor probes: prompt-template variants + quantization + batch sizes + KV cache toggles.
- Observed consistent latency cliffs when BATCH>=8 for seq_len>512 on A100 q4_0 builds; seems thresholded by kernel selection per runtime.
- Cost delta (rough) between q8_0 and q4_0 ~ 20-30% depending on throughput; quality drop small on classification prompts but visible on multi-turn summarization.

Quick run table (most recent first):
ID | date | model | q | batch | seq | est latency (ms) | tokens/req | approx $/1k toks | metric (acc/ROUGE) | notes
P-2025-03A | 2025-03-01 | redwood-l2-small | q4_0 | 8 | 640 | 420 | 950 | 0.045 | ROUGE-L 0.67 (prompt A v2), decode instability 2/50
P-2025-02Z | 2025-02-28 | redwood-l2-small | q8_0 | 8 | 640 | 310 | 950 | 0.061 | ROUGE-L 0.70, stable
P-2025-02Y | 2025-02-26 | redwood-l2-small | q4_0 | 4 | 512 | 220 | 750 | 0.052 | notable KV cache warmup (first token set high)
P-2025-02X | 2025-02-22 | redwood-l2-medium | q8_0 | 16 | 256 | 185 | 640 | 0.075 | good throughput, tail latency spikes when concurrent 30+
P-2025-02W | 2025-02-18 | redwood-l2-small | float16 | 1 | 128 | 35 | 210 | 0.12 | baseline single-shot latency for short prompts

Notes on measurements and reliability:
- Latency measured via local harness (rt-runner) + console traces; add ~5-10% for network to hosted API.
- Cost approximations use current pricing schedule + token estimates; treat as order-of-magnitude only.
- Metric column mixes task-specific scores: classification accuracy for short answer sets, ROUGE for summarization. Not consistent across rows (intentional for quick compare).

Fragments / hypotheses to validate:
- H1: q4_0 performance cliffs tied to kernel fallback path when seq>512 -> causes extra memory copies. Need trace from runtime to confirm (ticket JIRA-ENG-3142).
- H2: small-batch (<4) with warmed KV cache gives best latency for multi-turn; look into auto-batching window tuning.
- H3: quantization quality gap primarily shows up on generation (summarization/dialog) vs classification; consider hybrid routing (classify on q4_0, summarize on q8_0).

Small checklist / next actions:
- [ ] Ask infra to attach gpu trace for P-2025-03A (Ethan) — collect kernel selection log.
- [ ] Re-run P-2025-02Y with batch 2 and explicit kv-cache-warm toggle to compare warm vs cold. (this week)
- [ ] Draft short note for product showing cost/quality tradeoffs for q4_0 vs q8_0 (target: 1 page)
- [ ] Add a micro-eval set for hallucination-sensitivity on summarization prompts (10 items)
- [ ] Sync with Lina on model pinning strategy for Dedicated pools (impact on routing)

Prompt templates snapshot (used in the above runs):
- Prompt A v1: "Summarize the following conversation in one paragraph, preserving factual statements and avoiding hallucinations. Conversation:
{chat_history}
Summary:"
- Prompt A v2: shorter anchor + explicit oracle-check: "Summarize conversation below in <=3 sentences and list any statements you are unsure about preceded by 'UNCERTAIN:'.
{chat_history}
Summary:"
- Classification probe: "Given text: {doc}, label as [POSITIVE|NEUTRAL|NEGATIVE]. One-word answer."

Observations / loose thoughts:
- The "UNCERTAIN:" trick reduces low-confidence hallucinations in q8_0 but q4_0 still occasionally fabricates when context >4 turns.
- When running with batch>=8, p95 jumps more than p50 -> implies queueing/packing edge effects. Maybe tune batch window to 30ms to let small requests through.
- Could try per-route small-batch overrides for routes with tight p99 SLAs.

Experimental record (quick):
- Warm-cold: track first-request latency separately (I used field est latency which often reflects warmed). Need to add explicit columns next time: first_lat, warmed_p50, warmed_p95.
- Quality: save examples for failing rows to the shared bench bucket (path: s3://bench-examples/aq/iterative-probe-collage/). Will upload after cleaning.

Random notes-to-self:
- If we keep q4_0 as default for low-cost tier, ensure fallback path for long sequences maps to q8_0 automatically to avoid the kernel cliff.
- Consider a small eval harness that runs both quantization variants and flags >5% ROUGE delta.

History & provenance:
- This file started 2025-02-11 as a raw series of run notes; gradually consolidated into the table above. Meant to be ephemeral unless we formalize a short memo.

End-of-file quick log:
- 2025-03-01 17:12: saved run P-2025-03A; high p95 noted.
- 2025-02-28 10:05: compared q8_0 vs q4_0; q8_0 wins on quality for summarization
- 2025-02-22 09:42: medium model stress test (concurrency 40) showed p99 failures; file a bug if reproduction consistent.

If I come back: re-run a compact grid: q in [q4_0,q8_0], batch in [1,2,4,8], seq in [128,256,512,768], model in [small,medium]; store examples with bad ROUGE and attach traces.
